name: alimama-mcp
description: 阿里妈妈 Alimama (ads): me, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume. Every tool maps to

platform_mcp_alimama_app_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIMAMA_APP_KEY
platform_mcp_alimama_app_key.description: AppKey of a 淘宝开放平台 application granted the 阿里妈妈 万相台无界 API permission (https://open.taobao.com).

platform_mcp_alimama_app_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIMAMA_APP_SECRET
platform_mcp_alimama_app_secret.description: AppSecret of that application; never sent, used for the MD5 request signature.

platform_mcp_alimama_session.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIMAMA_SESSION
platform_mcp_alimama_session.description: Seller session key (授权信息 'session') issued when the merchant authorised the app through the TOP OAuth flow (https://open.taobao.com/doc.htm?docId=101617&docType=1: session is required for APIs marked 需要授权); renew it by re-authorising when it expires.

platform_mcp_alimama_biz_code.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIMAMA_BIZ_CODE
platform_mcp_alimama_biz_code.description: 万相台无界 scene code (api业务线编码) sent in top_service_context, e.g. onebpDisplay (人群推广), onebpSearch (关键词推广) or onebpSite (全站推广); taobao.universalbp.new.account.get.can.use.bizcode lists the codes the account may use.

tools.name: me
tools.description: taobao.universalbp.new.account.get.can.use.bizcode (获取账户可用的bizCode): the marketing scenes the authorised account can use, each {biz_code, app_id, market_name}.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: taobao.universalbp.new.campaign.findpage (查询计划分页列表) for the configured biz_code scene, paged with campaign_query_v_o {offset, page_size}. Each campaign has campaign_id, campaign_name, display_status (start 正在推广, pause 暂停推广, terminate, wait, pending, wait_pay), online_status, dmc_type and day_budget (a string in 元, left in raw), launch_time, promotion_scene, optimize_target. account_id and status are not sent (the session selects the shop; status_list would need its own JSON array).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: taobao.universalbp.new.report.query.campaign (计划报表查询): per day and campaign (query_domains date, campaign; split_type day; last-click attribution zhai over 15 days) with ad_pv, click, charge (花费, 元), ctr, ecpc; first 100 rows. campaign_id is not applied (filter rows by campaign_id); account_id is not sent (the session selects the shop).

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: taobao.universalbp.new.campaign.budget.batchupdate (批量更新计划预算) with budget_list [{campaign_id, dmc_type: normal (日预算), day_budget (元)}]. This spends money. A rejected campaign is reported inside a successful response (raw.campaign_budget_update_result_v_o_top_part_data.error_details, info.ok) rather than as an error. currency is ignored (CNY).

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: pause → taobao.universalbp.new.campaign.oneclick (一键暂停), resume → taobao.universalbp.new.campaign.onerecover (一键恢复, https://open.taobao.com/api.htm?docId=70472&docType=2), each with one_click_v_o {campaign_id_list: [campaign_id]}; the answer is top_result.info {ok, message, error_code} (see raw). Resuming restarts spend.
